rationale: Candidate 2770b81ba60170192e7ca5c16b6677226cc7acd7 offers an exceptionally fluent, punchy Italian translation that perfectly captures Dan's informal yet authoritative voice. The phrasing ('È ora delle stringhe di connessione...', 'un assortimento eterogeneo', 'vibe-anno') sounds much more natural and polished than candidate 6048e3cc2caf151b79965fee3dc66ad847d0be26 ('È ora di stringhe...', 'anno vibe fa', clunky phrasing in the footnote).
